title: Server Scan — Fleet & Collectors
description: Fleet health, vendor collectors, OpenShift membership jobs, login and external calls, the audit trail, the ingest skip rate and the API and frontend pods for the server-scan inventory platform. Built from app.observability.metrics + the server_scan: recording rules in deploy/helm/server-scan/templates/backend-prometheusrule.yaml. Every panel de-duplicates the HA Prometheus pair with max without (prometheus, prometheus_replica). Requires metrics.serviceMonitor.enabled and metrics.prometheusRule.enabled on the Helm chart.

list.name: namespace
list.label: Namespace
list.description: The one namespace the app runs in. Edit it once per environment (Dashboard settings -> Variables).

panels.title: Total servers
panels.description: sum(server_scan:servers:max) — the fleet, filtered by the Collector variable.

panels.title: Duplicate name groups
panels.description: Distinct names shared by more than one document.

panels.title: Fleet gauge query failures (15m)
panels.description: server_scan_fleet_snapshot_failures_total — every server_scan_* gauge freezes at its last value when this fires. Almost always MongoDB.

targets.expr: count(max without (prometheus, prometheus_replica) (ALERTS{alertname=~"ServerScan.*", alertstate="firing", namespace=~"$namespace"})) or vector(0)

panels.title: Servers installed under a different name
panels.description: server_scan:openshift_name_mismatch_servers:max — servers whose OpenShift-reported hostname differs from their current inventory name (a vendor-manager rename after install).

panels.title: Contested servers (claimed by two OpenShift jobs)
panels.description: server_scan:openshift_contested_servers:max — servers two clusters or MCEs keep flipping between within an hour (the inventory's Duplicate Server filter).

panels.title: Collector silence age
panels.description: server_scan:collector_silent_seconds — time() - max(collector_last_seen_timestamp_seconds). Fires ServerScanCollectorSilent above silentForSeconds (default 43200s = 12h, dashed line).

panels.title: Stale servers per collector
panels.description: server_scan:servers_stale:max — not seen within INVENTORY_STALE_AFTER_SECONDS, or never seen. Fires ServerScanServersStale above staleServersThreshold (default 10).

panels.title: Unreachable servers per collector
panels.description: server_scan:servers_unreachable:max — of the stale ones, a BMC that did not answer.

panels.title: Partially-read servers per collector
panels.description: server_scan:servers_partial:max — reached, but a field this collector normally reports came back unread this run.

panels.title: Last run exited PARTIAL
panels.description: server_scan:collector_last_run_partial:max — 1 if the most recent run did not see the whole fleet.

panels.title: Membership run silence age
panels.description: server_scan:membership_run_silent_seconds — time() - max(membership_last_run_timestamp_seconds), per kind/reported_by. Fires ServerScanMembershipRunSilent above membershipSilentForSeconds (default 1800s = two 15-min nodes-status cycles) independent of match rate — this is what catches a job that runs but matches zero hostnames, which cluster_last_reported_timestamp_seconds below cannot see at all.

panels.title: Unmatched hostnames per run
panels.description: server_scan:membership_last_run_unmatched:max — hostnames the job reported that matched no server this run. Fires ServerScanMembershipUnmatched above membershipUnmatchedThreshold (default 0). The newest job pod's log lists the actual hostnames.

panels.title: Membership run summary (latest)
panels.description: One row per kind/reported_by: what the most recent real run of tools.collect_openshift reported.

panels.title: Servers held per cluster
panels.description: server_scan:cluster_servers_held:max — INSTALLED servers naming this cluster (nodes jobs only; agents/MCE holdings are not broken out separately).

panels.title: Cluster membership-job silence age (last run)
panels.description: server_scan:cluster_silent_seconds: seconds since the newest completed membership run (nodes or agents) of each cluster, from the run record written on every real run, so it stays near the job schedule on a healthy cluster even when nothing changes. Fires ServerScanClusterSilent above membershipSilentForSeconds (default 1800s). Panel 17 is the per-job view.

panels.title: Top firing health policies
panels.description: server_scan:policy_active:max — how many servers each declarative health policy currently fires on (top 15). policy_key shadowing means a server counts once per category, not once per policy.

panels.title: Fleet size over time and pruned servers
Total servers (and by collector)
panels.description: Fleet count over time: the total line plus one line per source_provider, from server_scan_servers (MongoDB count). A step down is a prune or a removed collector.

panels.title: Servers pruned (last 24h window)
panels.description: Servers deleted by the prune tool in the trailing 24h, per collector, from audit events of type SERVER_PRUNED (server_scan_servers_pruned_24h). WHICH servers: Prometheus carries no names. Query GET /api/v1/events?event_type=SERVER_PRUNED (name, serial, vendor, manager, last_seen_at, reason are in each event's data), or grep the server.pruned log line.

options.content: Server names are deliberately not Prometheus labels (cardinality). Look them up in the audit log: `GET /api/v1/events?event_type=SERVER_PRUNED` (newest first, paged; each event's `data` holds name, serial, vendor, source_provider, manager_id, listed_at, last_seen_at, reason). The same facts are in the `server.pruned` structlog line in the collector/prune job logs.

panels.title: Logins by outcome
panels.description: server_scan:auth_logins:rate5m — success, wrong_password, no_permission, throttled, unavailable (LDAP or the AD API failed), error.

panels.title: POST /auth/login latency (p95 / p99)
panels.description: The login route alone. The fleet-wide HTTP latency panel hides a few slow logins among thousands of probes and polls (2026-10-06 incident).

panels.title: Logins refused with 503 (15m)
panels.description: auth_logins_total{outcome=unavailable}: LDAP, the AD API or the login deadline failed. A wrong password is 401 and never counts here.

targets.expr: sum(max without (prometheus, prometheus_replica) (increase(auth_logins_total{namespace=~"$namespace", outcome="unavailable"}[15m]))) or vector(0)

panels.title: External call latency p95 by dependency
panels.description: ldap, ad_api, and vendor_<manager> (GET /servers/available's live recheck). server_scan:dependency_call_duration_seconds:p95.

panels.title: External call failures by dependency and reason
panels.description: server_scan:dependency_calls:rate5m without the non-failure outcomes (ok, invalid_credentials, verified, not_found, cancelled). The outcome is the reason: connect_timeout, read_timeout, http_503, receive_timeout, failed, ...

panels.title: Logins by outcome (last 24h)
panels.description: auth_logins_total over 24 hours, per outcome: success, wrong_password, no_permission (valid login but the account is in no admin, auditor or viewer list), throttled, unavailable (LDAP, the AD API or the login deadline failed) and error. A rare outcome is invisible as a per-second rate; this counts it. Every outcome starts at 0 when the API starts, so a missing bar means that pod has not been scraped yet.

panels.title: Audit events stored
panels.description: server_scan:audit_events:max: audit events in MongoDB (events older than collectors.auditRetention.retentionDays are deleted).

panels.title: Oldest audit event age
panels.description: server_scan:audit_oldest_event_age_seconds in days. Reads about 0 when there are no events (an unlabelled gauge cannot be absent). Should stay under retentionDays once the retention job is out of report-only.

panels.title: Events per user (last 24h)
panels.description: Audit events per actor in the last 24 hours: AD users who logged in and changed things (maintenance, reservations, reclassify), the admin/auditor/viewer API tokens, and system jobs (ingestion, prune, audit retention, one per OpenShift cluster or MCE membership job). Shows who and what is writing.

panels.title: Events per user (all stored)
panels.description: The same per actor over every stored event (the numbers beside each name in the Events page User filter); events older than collectors.auditRetention.retentionDays are deleted.

panels.title: 403 responses by path
panels.description: Every 403: a client still using a viewer token on /api/v1/events (the audit trail is admin/auditor only), a viewer or auditor calling a write endpoint, or a valid login with no permission on /api/v1/auth/login.

panels.title: Unchanged share of the last run, per collector
panels.description: server_scan:collector_last_run_unchanged_ratio: the fraction of fetched servers the last run found unchanged and did not rewrite. Low on a collector that should be quiet means something is churning stored content.

panels.title: Servers fetched vs unchanged, per collector
panels.description: The last run's fetched count and how many of those were unchanged and not rewritten. A collector whose last run was recorded before this count existed shows 0 unchanged until it next runs.

panels.title: API replicas available / desired
panels.description: server_scan:api_replicas_available:ratio: API pods scraped as up over backend.replicaCount (leaf mode, the default) or ready over desired (thanos-ruler mode); below 100% means a pod is down or not ready. Platform series (kube-state-metrics, cAdvisor): empty in the default metrics.prometheusRule.evaluationScope=leaf-prometheus mode, where only the API replica and restart panels have data. Memory, CPU, frontend and waiting-pod panels need evaluationScope=thanos-ruler plus those series in this datasource (see deploy/README.md).

panels.title: Frontend replicas available / desired
panels.description: server_scan:frontend_replicas_available:ratio. No data when frontend.enabled is false. Platform series (kube-state-metrics, cAdvisor): empty in the default metrics.prometheusRule.evaluationScope=leaf-prometheus mode, where only the API replica and restart panels have data. Memory, CPU, frontend and waiting-pod panels need evaluationScope=thanos-ruler plus those series in this datasource (see deploy/README.md).

panels.title: Container restarts in 30m
panels.description: Restarts of the api and frontend containers over the last 30 minutes (the ServerScan*Restarting alerts fire above podRestartsThreshold). Platform series (kube-state-metrics, cAdvisor): empty in the default metrics.prometheusRule.evaluationScope=leaf-prometheus mode, where only the API replica and restart panels have data. Memory, CPU, frontend and waiting-pod panels need evaluationScope=thanos-ruler plus those series in this datasource (see deploy/README.md).

panels.title: Memory: usage, request and limit
panels.description: Working set per pod (solid lines) against the memory request (dashed orange) and limit (dashed red) of each container. Request and limit are per container, so one line each for api and frontend. Needs the platform series container_memory_working_set_bytes and kube_pod_container_resource_requests/limits (kube-state-metrics, cAdvisor) in this datasource.

targets.expr: max by (container) (max without (prometheus, prometheus_replica) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{namespace=~"$namespace", container=~"api|frontend", pod=~".+-(api|frontend)-[a-z0-9]+-[a-z0-9]+", resource="memory"}))

max by (container) (max without (prometheus, prometheus_replica) (kube_pod_container_resource_limits{namespace=~"$namespace", container=~"api|frontend", pod=~".+-(api|frontend)-[a-z0-9]+-[a-z0-9]+", resource="memory"}))

panels.title: CPU: usage, request and limit (cores)
panels.description: CPU use per pod (solid lines) against the CPU request (dashed orange) and limit (dashed red) of each container, in cores. The chart sets a CPU request but no CPU limit, so the limit line only appears once you set a CPU limit in backend.resources or frontend.resources. Needs the platform series container_cpu_usage_seconds_total and kube_pod_container_resource_requests/limits (kube-state-metrics, cAdvisor) in this datasource.

targets.expr: max by (container) (max without (prometheus, prometheus_replica) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{namespace=~"$namespace", container=~"api|frontend", pod=~".+-(api|frontend)-[a-z0-9]+-[a-z0-9]+", resource="cpu"}))

max by (container) (max without (prometheus, prometheus_replica) (kube_pod_container_resource_limits{namespace=~"$namespace", container=~"api|frontend", pod=~".+-(api|frontend)-[a-z0-9]+-[a-z0-9]+", resource="cpu"}))

panels.title: Pods waiting or OOMKilled
panels.description: Containers currently waiting in CrashLoopBackOff, ImagePullBackOff and similar, and containers whose last termination was OOMKilled (that row stays until the pod is replaced or ends for another reason). Empty is healthy. Platform series (kube-state-metrics, cAdvisor): empty in the default metrics.prometheusRule.evaluationScope=leaf-prometheus mode, where only the API replica and restart panels have data. Memory, CPU, frontend and waiting-pod panels need evaluationScope=thanos-ruler plus those series in this datasource (see deploy/README.md).
